Thanks Alice - that timeline works. Quick answers to your two questions so your review can keep moving: 

- Data retention: We expose configurable retention policies per-tenant for Private and Dedicated deployments; Hosted exposes retention controls via the Console with exportable logs. We'll include an explicit mapping table in a one-pager for your legal team.
- Audit trails / per-tenant logs: Private deployments can be configured to ship per-tenant audit logs to your SIEM/Kafka or S3. Dedicated/Hosted provide audit logs via the control plane; for Dedicated we can set up an isolated log-forwarding arrangement.

I'll attach a short one-pager summarizing those two items and schedule a 30-min slot with Vivek for Wed. If there's anything else that would unblock procurement/legal, flag it now and I'll prioritize.
